testMatrix.contract: Stable ID, unchanged short prize, saved destination, exact recorded message link, running state, localized stored deadline and saved-not-observed wording
Saved destination survives an unconfirmed message; explicit unknown/pending state and no fabricated message link; a channel-only destination link is allowed
Missing saved display detail remains distinguishable from an empty list and does not fabricate a link
Explicit paused and saved-state wording, destination retained, no relative timestamp or running-countdown claim

Ten 64-byte IDs and valid long astral/mention/backtick/newline prizes, mixed recorded/pending and paused/open rows, foreign-guild sentinel, bounded complete replies, explicit prize elision, whole-row facts and no silent quota loss
Foreign-only fixture is honestly empty, never disclosed or unavailable
Real local SQL read-name failure yields safe unavailable response, no empty success, details or mutations
Denied/missing staff permissions and disabled feature preserve private refusals; absent/foreign guild preserve the existing silent Ignore fence; no stored-detail disclosure or effects
Twelve same-actor lists leave saved state unchanged and preserve the actual subsequent entry consumer's budget

sharedOracles: Real CommandRuntime dispatch, router, SQL persistence and reply executor; only Discord transport is doubled.
Every captured list effect is its own private interaction callback, completion or explicit bounded private continuation; no channel/message REST reads, public sends or other effects.

Each complete visible reply is at most 2000 UTF-16 units, valid Unicode and mention-suppressed. At most three automatically returned messages; multi-message continuation must be explicit. Each giveaway is one complete row.

Full definitions/entries/draws/automation-audit snapshots preserve every field including nonce, claim, pause and scheduling timestamps. Nontransactional statement-trigger witnesses detect even rolled-back, restored or failed write attempts.
Prizes and IDs intentionally do not contain the state words asserted by their single-row oracle. Expectations are literal fixture facts, not derived by production renderers.
handoff: Expected statuses are a test matrix, not execution evidence. Cache refusal and compilation failures are not behavior-specific RED. Observed output and immutable head are recorded in the issue handoff report.

Consume the published exact commit in the implementation task's isolated workspace without switching or repointing its harness branch. Preserve the protected file byte-for-byte and verify this manifest. Test corrections belong to the Test Author.
Do not merge deliberately failing tests alone. The implementation owner supplies combined exact-head GREEN, independent review and squash auto-merge.
Existing create/entry, delivery cleanup, inspect/preview, lifecycle decoder and audit work remain untouched. The only shared-file change is additive test module registration.
No eligibility, winner policy, quotas, new commands, activation, deployment, production testing, migrations or scheduler/claim/nonce/audit behavior change is authorized by this fixture.
